name: loan-manager
description: Loan tracking application for loans and repayments (daily/weekly/monthly, flat & reducing-balance interest).

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run generate --workspace server && npm run deploy --workspace server && npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace client
